inj.note: Nelson's absence doesn't come as much of a surprise, given that he underwent a minor procedure on his injured knee Monday. He's currently considered week-to-week, and with the Seahawks on a bye for Week 11, Nelson could return for Week 12 against the 49ers on Sunday, Nov. 29. Grey Zabel will likely start at left guard Sunday in Nelson's stead.

news.h: Seahawks' Quenton Nelson, Sam Darnold among starters ruled out
news.d: New Seahawks trade acquisition Quenton Nelson will have a "minor procedure" and is one of six starters, including QB Sam Darnold, who won't play vs. the Cardinals.
